answer: Under GDPR Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 83 – General conditions for imposing administrative fines – sets the maximum administrative fine at up to 20,000,000 EUR, or up to 4% of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
